ui_bugs.component: Results screen — stat stickers color override
ui_bugs.issue: The three stat stickers (CORRECT / ACCURACY / GLOBAL RANK) are meant to display the vivid STAT_FILLS colors (#FF9F1C orange, #2EC4B6 teal, #00B8FF blue) per results.tsx:14+88-99, but they render as dark grey. RCA: <Sticker fill={STAT_FILLS[i]} contentStyle={styles.statCard} /> passes styles.statCard as the last item in the face style array (Sticker.tsx:38), and styles.statCard sets backgroundColor: colors.surfaceSecondary (results.tsx:159), which overrides the fill. Fix: remove `backgroundColor: colors.surfaceSecondary` from styles.statCard so the Sticker's fill shows through (or pass a variant that doesn't set backgroundColor).

ui_bugs.component: Home config sheet — last-selected-sport guard has no user feedback
ui_bugs.issue: Tapping the currently-only-selected sports chip (e.g., mix-sport-basketball when it's the only one selected) correctly no-ops and keeps at least one sport selected, but there is no toast/haptic/visual indication telling the user why. Users may think the tap didn't register. Suggest firing a toast like 'Pick at least one sport' when guarding the last chip.

rca_of_issue: Results stat card grey-out RCA: In /app/frontend/src/components/Sticker.tsx:29-39, the face() style array places `contentStyle` AFTER `{ backgroundColor: fill, ... }`. In /app/frontend/app/results.tsx:88-99 the three stat Stickers pass `contentStyle={styles.statCard}`, and styles.statCard (line 159) sets `backgroundColor: colors.surfaceSecondary`. Because React Native flattens style arrays left-to-right with later entries winning, `colors.surfaceSecondary` overrides the intended STAT_FILLS[i] color. Reproduce: play any solo quiz to results and observe CORRECT/ACCURACY/GLOBAL RANK cards render dark instead of vivid orange/teal/blue. Mitigation: remove `backgroundColor: colors.surfaceSecondary` from styles.statCard OR set it to 'transparent' OR modify Sticker.tsx to spread contentStyle BEFORE the backgroundColor object so fill always wins.
